shared_elements: procession/rank of figures shown striding in profile
hair and beard rendered in tight ordered curls
figures holding objects in raised hands
register/panel format with figures aligned along a baseline
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief bearded figures in strict profile, striding with one leg advanced, long pleated robes and elaborately curled hair, holding objects in the hands, aligned on a common baseline in a register. The decisive difference is that B depicts a single monumental composite creature with a raptor's head and huge multi-tiered wings carrying a bucket, while A shows a repeated row of wholly human attendants with no wings or animal heads.
